answer: Rotating witness lottery. Each epoch a verifiable beacon selects a small witness panel from all agent identities; panel members co-sign every new registration and earn ocean credits, while identities never selected starve. An attacker must hold many identities through repeated unselected epochs, paying full maintenance and losing the falcon slot each round. Forgery is blocked because panel choice is unpredictable until the velvet commit reveals, so precomputing panel membership is impossible.
